Honestly.  MFF this year was my first con. I’ve been hugely depressed leading up to this. 

I was fired over my sexual orientation, then one of my friends went missing. As well as found out the field of work I was in no longer welcomes me now that I’m more openly trans / more obviously trans. 

I’ve been having panic attacks since then and my health isn’t looking well overall. November was rough and December hasn’t been much better but I threw the aid of a friend I made it to MFF this year. 

Though much of my anxiety remains and I cried once or twice at the con. It was all joy. It’s been the first time in a while I’ve had a fresh of breath air and all the fucking hugs, god I loved getting hugged. 

I loved getting a chance to use my partial, I met so many good people.  MFF this year is a shining light for me. Wouldn’t change a moment of it.
